query_token: None is appended by source serializer or collator; last observed token is pooled. With EBV=NA this final token changes; omission also changes pooled field.

variants.source_exact_na: Exact source field names/order/precision, MW_EBV=NA. Source survey schema and PDR2 field aliases are COUNTERFACTUAL diagnostic tags, not CLAUDS catalogue provenance.
variants.source_exact_omit_ebv: Same diagnostic mapping, omit unavailable EBV; changes final pooling field.
variants.target_schema_na: Keep all photometry fixed, change only schema survey identifier galaxiesml-spec -> clauds. PDR2 names remain diagnostic aliases.

target_photometry: Actual raw CLAUDS HSC grizy; microJy scaled linearly; measured signed fluxes kept; no invented EBV or uncertainties.
